book.name: 2 Korint
book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Krali Mz Lr Korint

content: Pol Ayzlubzle Natq Leplz Kcng Tzpibqtilr Nide

Mzli ka, ninge Pol, sa na-ayzlubo natq leplz kcng tzpibqtilr ninge, mz nzrpikr kzdung nimu kx trngini-angidrngeu aposol. Nzycmne-krdr kxmule lc murde pnanatix nimu mz letz scngeng, a' vz-nrwx-ngrbo bamu mzli kc tqmnc-ngrgu badr. A' mz nzvz-nqblq-krnge Kxnzmcpx, avzo-lzbqx x vz-nrwx-ngrbo bamu, mz nzrlxti-krbo bamu kx bzkq pibqtipeamu ninge.
Mzli kc navz-ngrmc bamu, trsutiu drtwrnge nzpnanati-mou-krnge nimu mz nzayrplapx-krnge nimu. A' mwx sa na-alebo da lc mz leplz kcng tzrpilr kx vz-nqblqkr drtwr leplz mz nrlc ka.
Kxmule-esz' mnckr mz nrlc, a' trotablr-nqblqkru nqmq kr lr nrlc mz nzotablr-krgr badr leplz kcng tzrpwa'-ngrmlr nzwz-krgr.

Murde zmatq ngr nzota-krgr trvzpxpuu mz natq leplz kxtrnzrlxngitiung mz nzesabrtingr leplz. A' plzpxkr natq angidr kx kam Gct bagr. X natqdeng nzrngiscng zmatq ngr nzodatingr nqmq nr drtwr kznikeng trngiu da angidr. Natq lcng xplr x nzkrlzlr nzbatr-krbzlr mz leplz nztekqtr-krdr nqmq nr drtwrdr. Murde nqmq nr drtwrdr lcng tzvz-rbrng nzapulr lrpalvc kx xplr kx nzawxongr mz zmatq ngr Gct.

Murde milxtxokr drtwr x nzycmnengr amrlx kcng tzrpwa'-ngrbzlr mz leplz nzkrlz-angidr-krdr Gct. X aovxiokr nqmq nr drtwr lcng amrlx tzvz-rbrng, murde nzaotikr drtwr leplz da navz-nqblq-txpwzle me pnz drtwr Kxnzmcpx.
X mzli kc navz-ngrmgr bamu x namc-ngrbzkr krkcng nzmnclzpebzng mz Kxnzmcpx, sa na-ayrplapx-atekr nimu kcng tzxpqbrlr-ngrdr nide mz nzpxtxpx-krmu nzmnclz-krmamu bagr.
Leplz kcng tzpibqtilr nigr nzrpilr kx nidr leplz neng Kxnzmcpx. A' nakrlz-angidramu x leplz lcng nakrlz-kzlr kx nigr kz leplz nedeng.
Drtqnge trmyau mz nzglqpx-lzbq-krgr mz zmatq kc tqkaom Kxetu rgu bagr. Murde zmatq lc ngi dalr nzokatr-krgr nimu mz nztu-amqngi-krmu mz nzrlxngiti-krmu, a' trngiu dalr nzatrkatingr nimu.
Dekc trsutiu drtwrnge nzmwxlrti-krmu ninge mz natq kcng tqyrbo bamu mz letz scngeng.
Krlzx kx kzdung nimu nzrpilr kx, “Nzycmnekr Pol mz letz scdeng matq-esz'ngr. A' mzli kcng tqmnc-ngrgu badr apunede ncblo kxmane x nzycmne-krde trxplru.”
A' rngidrlvz-ngrbo mz leplz lcng, kx mzli kc namnc-ngrgu badr, sa na-atutr-angidrkr natq amrlx kcng tqyrbzkr mz letz scgrng, mz nzaelwapx-krbzkr bamu kx rngiscgr zmatq.

Trmrlzu nzrpi-krgr kx apukr leplz lcng. Murde nzrpilr kx nidr leplz kxnztubqng x nzmyapxbzng mz kzdung kz kxnzetung. A' mz nzaotikr drtwrdr nike tubq x myapxbz, nzobqtitxtrpwzlr nidr esz'-krdr. Krlc aelwapx-ngrde kx nzngqngu-angidrng.
A' trapukru nidr. Murde glqpx-lzbqtx-ngrpwzkr zmatq kc tqkaom Gct bagr. X nimu amrlx ngrmu mnclzmamu bagr mz zmatq lc.

Nzmu trnayapwxtipxpwzkru Nrpakxmrlz bamu, vz-rbrkr mz nzrpi-krgr kx namnclzmamu mz zmatq ngrgr. A' ryapwxpx-ayrnr-ngrbzkr Nrpakxmrlz bamu. X rngiscgr zmatq ngr nzngini-krgr aposol kcng tqmnclzbzmu badr. X krkcng tzvzmqng mz nibrgr trnzrngiscung zmatq lc.

Trglqpx-lzbq-ngrgru nzwzngr kx nzale kzdung kz leplz, da kc tzwailr. A' obqtipxkr mzli kc nabrpengr nzrlxngiti-krmu, murde mzli lc nakrlzamu nzokatr-krmu nigr mz nzvzpx-krgr mrkang kqlu mz nzyapwxtipx-mou-krgr Nrpakxmrlz.
Murde suti drtwrgr nzyapwxtipx-krbzkrle mz leplz kcng trnzxlrkalr Nrpa lc. X dekc krlzkr nzglqpx-lzbqtx-krpwzkr nzwz-krgr esz'-krgr, a' trngiu nzwzkr kzdu-kzng leplz.
X nzglqpx-lzbq-krgr mz nzwz-krgr lc, vz-nqblqle Nzryrngrkxtr kx rpile kx, “Trtakitrdeu doa nzglqpx-lzbq-krde mz nike alele, a' naglqpx-txpwzle Yawe mz nike alele.”
Murde kxnzglqpx-lzbqng esz'-krdr trabrtzlvzu Gct nidr, a' nide esz'-krde kx takitrde nzglqpx-krde leplz kcng tqabrtzlvzleng nidr.
